newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIAN STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIAN STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: Turnover rose to 253,170 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 38,330 denars on Thursday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold 261 shares at 970 denars, down 1,480 from Thursday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 70 stocks at the previous session.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
